description: This file defines a PHP trait for an HTTP client, providing method signatures and default implementations for sending synchronous and asynchronous HTTP requests for various HTTP methods, including GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD, and PATCH. It also specifies abstract methods for request creation and handling exceptions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP GET request using the request method with 'GET' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP HEAD request using the request method with 'HEAD' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP PUT request using the request method with 'PUT' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP POST request using the request method with 'POST' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP PATCH request using the request method with 'PATCH' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP DELETE request using the request method with 'DELETE' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: getAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP GET request using the requestAsync method with 'GET' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: headAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP HEAD request using the requestAsync method with 'HEAD' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: putAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP PUT request using the requestAsync method with 'PUT' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: postAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP POST request using the requestAsync method with 'POST' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: patchAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP PATCH request using the requestAsync method with 'PATCH' as the HTTP method.

methods.name: deleteAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP DELETE request using the requestAsync method with 'DELETE' as the HTTP method.
